tool_args.rationale: The observations show a monotone-concave response over a narrow u_now range, but do not uniquely identify the quantitative law. The forecast horizon already matches the target, so acquire the lower-cost open-branch probe to resolve model-family ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: author a saturating or Haldane response model from the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows vary only u_now; they cannot identify how s_grad or the other inputs contribute, and several concave response families can fit this narrow sweep.
A denser sweep of the same narrow input trajectory is less useful than an observation designed to distinguish branches.
It does not address the relevant model ambiguity and is explicitly not worth its cost.
